docs.title: Time Calculator Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for Time Calculator, a Python utility that calculates time by adding a duration to a start time with optional weekday handling.

docs.title: 🚀 Features
docs.text:
• Supports 12-hour AM/PM format
  • Handles day-of-week input (case-insensitive)
  • Reports day rollovers (next day / N days later)
  • No dependencies
  • Clean and predictable formatting

docs.title: add_time(start_time, duration, start_day=None)
docs.text: Add a duration to a start time in 12-hour format, optionally rolling over days and updating the weekday.

docs.title: 📌 Function Signature
docs.text: ```python add_time(start_time: str, duration: str, start_day: str | None = None) -> str

docs.title: Basic Example
docs.text: ```python from time_calculator import add_time print(add_time("3:30 PM", "2:12"))
